aliases: KR-BIOCOMM-ZERO-01 Formal Foundations and Testable Propositions
note: Reformulation of the initial KR-BIOCOMM-ZERO-01 proposal (kr-biocomm-zero-01-initial-proposal, B0067) into disciplined formal definitions and witness-search propositions; distinguishes quotient (~_Pi) vs observation/projection (Pi:K->V) dual formulations of the preservation-Zero criterion, and defines ActionStable via policy invariance.

A four-document (01-04) independent-verification package (2026-09-07) consolidating and re-verifying ~60 Gita-KnowledgeOS correspondences already scattered across the estate (artifacts 18-35, R2-TRANSLATION-REGISTER, D285-8, REFINED-STEP-286), applying a T0-T4/T4-SHAPE tier scheme, independently re-checking the 'zero new primitives' claim, and closing the candidacy question negatively for the kernel while recommending three unexamined T3 rows and flagging one open decision (the Guna scale-type fork). Distinct from the earlier per-cycle Gita audits (gita-lens-cyclical-audit-2026-09, gita-candidate-register-and-nine-cycle-verdict) which this package explicitly consolidates and independently verifies rather than re-derives.

aliases: Algebraic Zero vs Representational Omission vs Preservation Zero
note: A new research artifact distinguishing three notions of 'zero' (algebraic zero element 0_i in a domain D_i; representational omission/restriction P_S^restrict; preservation-relative Zero_{T,Pi}) and specifying six hypotheses HZ1-HZ6 to test whether/how they relate, with HZ4 (observational equivalence of zero-projection and restriction) as the gate experiment. The initial draft reused the ID 'KR-ZOOM-01' for this different experiment, colliding with the pre-existing KR-ZOOM-01 (recursive-epistemic-zoom-resolution-relative-atomicity-2026-09, B0065); the immediate follow-up renames it KR-ZERO-RESOLUTION-2026-09 to avoid the collision. Connects Zero Algebra, Zoom/Resolution, and Biological Communication as three feeding research programmes.

A recommendation to pause new experiments (biological/Zoom/Zero) and instead build a capability-to-theory traceability audit classifying each claimed KnowledgeOS capability by evidentiary status, to identify which capabilities require new theory versus already being derivable from Theory v1.2.

A human anecdote (being asked 'Do you speak Urdu?' then asked for metro directions) formalized into a candidate 'epistemic agency' layer: observation->interpretation->intent hypothesis->clarification->inquiry->gap detection->gap classification->investigation selection->evidence->determination->action. Proposes NextEpistemicAct as a candidate function selecting the next epistemically useful operation, and reinterprets Lord/Sarathi as generate-candidate-actions vs select-among-them functions. Distinct from the older, unrelated 'inv-kos-agent-001-epistemic-agency' (B0006, a constitutional-invariant register row named Epistemic Agency); this is a candidate architecture/function, not a register row, so kept as a separate object though thematically adjacent.

aliases: What KnowledgeOS makes possible beyond conventional AI/RAG
note: A 60-capability catalogue arguing KnowledgeOS is an 'epistemic operating system' distinct from conventional AI/RAG (Unknown!=False, contradiction preserved as data, evidence lineage, source vs claim, evidence vs truth, truth vs determination, inquiry-relative retrieval, safe information reduction, hallucination as a diagnosable class, capability!=kernel-operator hierarchy, etc.), followed by a critique classifying claims by evidentiary maturity, correcting overclaiming rhetoric, and recommending a formal KR-CAPABILITY-TRACEABILITY-2026-09 matrix -- converging with the parallel recommendation in S2833.

aliases: From Knowledge State to Next Epistemic Act
note: The fully worked-out KR-EPISTEMIC-AGENCY-2026-09 research artifact (status [PROP][OPEN], Theory v1.2 frozen, kernel untouched): a metro-encounter case study formalized as a four-layer execution loop (front-end interaction, gap detection/classification, epistemic agency selection, determination/output), hypotheses EA1-EA7 plus later EA8-EA11, and an expected-utility sub-specification EU(a|K_t,Q_t,C_t,S_t,R_t). Extends the candidate 'next-epistemic-act-function-and-gap-classification' object (S2833) into a full formal specification with a worked six-step human trace and a senior-review critique correcting K|=Q notation, gap taxonomy exhaustiveness, EA7's universality, and the Lord/Sarathi naming.

aliases: Zoom-in as fact-finding discovery, not detail-inspection
note: Reframes Zoom-in from 'look at more detail inside a represented node' (the prior KR-ZOOM-01/02 formulation) to 'given a relevant observation, discover previously unrepresented dimensions/causal pathways and investigate them' -- an open-ended dimension-discovery operation feeding a FactFinding->Determination->ZoomOut(Integration) loop, proposed as a new artifact KR-ZOOM-FACTFINDING-2026-09 with hypotheses ZF1-ZF7. Marked POSSIBLY related to the existing recursive-epistemic-zoom-resolution-relative-atomicity-2026-09 (KR-ZOOM-01, B0065) since it is presented as a deeper reformulation of 'Zoom' in the same lineage, but the object here is discovery-of-new-dimensions rather than resolution-relative-atomicity of an existing coordinate, so the merge is uncertain.

aliases: Gita Chapter 2 as a source for inquiry-reframing
note: Uses a structural (not doctrinal) reading of Bhagavad Gita Chapter 2 -- an initially confused situation progressively investigated, reframed, and differentiated -- to propose that Fact-Finding may need to detect and repair a misframed or underspecified inquiry rather than only search for facts under the original question. Proposes Gap_missing != Gap_misinterpreted (a MisframedInquiry gap type, explicitly NOT yet added to the Zero taxonomy), redefines FactFindingComplete as reaching a declared adequacy condition (not merely Determine=True), and proposes KR-ZOOM-FACTFINDING-02 as a follow-on to KR-ZOOM-FACTFINDING-2026-09 (zoom-in-as-inquiry-directed-dimension-discovery).

aliases: Gita Chapter 3 -- from fact-finding to a justified reason for action
note: A structural (non-doctrinal) reading of Gita Chapter 3 proposing a second kind of fact-finding -- 'Action fact-finding' (why act, why this action) distinct from 'State fact-finding' (what is happening) -- introducing an ActionRationale object, the invariant Determine(H) does not imply Select(Action) and its converse, NoAction != NoDecision, and Action != ActorClaim / ObservedAction != CausalAttribution. Proposes KR-ACTION-FACTFINDING-2026-09 as the next artifact after KR-ZOOM-FACTFINDING, bridging to kr-epistemic-agency-2026-09-formal-specification.

notations: Theory v1.2 > Active Experiment > Downstream Proposals
aliases: Adjudicated KnowledgeOS Research Ledger and Artifact Status Matrix
note: The consolidated governance ledger for the whole 2026-09-07 metro/Zoom/ActionFactFinding research day: registers Theory v1.2 [FROZEN] and Minimal Kernel v1.0 [UNTOUCHED] as core baselines, KR-ZOOM-FACTFINDING-01 as the SOLE authorized active experiment, and KR-ACTION-FACTFINDING/KR-CH2-STRUCTURAL/KR-EPISTEMIC-AGENCY/KR-EXPECTED-UTILITY as downstream proposals with explicit prerequisite dependencies, enforcing the hierarchy Theory v1.2 > Active Experiment > Downstream Proposals and an isolation guardrail excluding action-warrant/utility/authorization/agency work from the current test.

aliases: Dynamic Epistemic Logic of Questions and Inquiry (thesis) as a KnowledgeOS research lens
note: An external formal-logic thesis on questions/issues (model M=<W,approx,sim,V> with a separate issue relation approx and epistemic indistinguishability sim) read as a structural (not adopted) source proposing KnowledgeState != InquiryState, ZoomIn as issue refinement, ZoomIn != FactFinding as independently motivated by 'questioning actions do not themselves give information', order-sensitive/non-commutative composition of questioning actions, and a behavioral-equivalence-first strategy relevant to the unresolved KnowledgeOS equiv_sem problem. Proposes KR-DELQ-INQUIRY-LENS-2026-09 with six research questions. NOTE (batch B0068, verified against later S2856): the source volume is subsequently identified as misattributed at some point in this thread (a 'source-misattribution-correction-the-volume-is-minica-not-sher' file appears later in this same batch, S2856) -- flagged here for cross-reference; this file's own attribution to 'Minica' is stated directly in-file and not contradicted within S2846 itself.

notations: Epistemic State != Epistemic Quality != Epistemic Value != Practical Value
aliases: Epistemic Value (ed. Haddock, Millar, Pritchard) as a KnowledgeOS research lens
note: An external philosophical anthology on the value of knowledge (Meno problem, swamping problem, understanding vs knowledge, curiosity/attention, pragmatic encroachment, epistemic pluralism) read as a structural source motivating Epistemic State != Epistemic Quality != Epistemic Value != Practical Value, a candidate vector-valued V_epi(K), and three candidate notions of success (Epistemic/Explanatory-Understanding/Practical-Action) that can diverge. Proposes KR-EPISTEMIC-VALUE-LENS-2026-09 with ten research questions EV1-EV10, explicitly not promoted into Theory v1.2.

notations: center/periphery are job descriptions not fixed locations
aliases: Gila Sher, Epistemic Friction -- Dynamic Structured Holism lens
note: Reads Gila Sher's 'Epistemic Friction' (a structured-holism epistemology where center/periphery are task-relative job descriptions, not fixed locations, and knowledge requires both epistemic freedom and epistemic friction as complementary conditions) as a structural source proposing a new Inquiry State I_t distinct from K_t, a dynamic Role_t(x|Q,C,S,R) attribution (Background/Focus/Candidate/EvidenceTarget/Hypothesis/Defeater/...), and a three-way discovery typology (new entity, role transition, relational activation) refining ZF2/ZF3. Registered as KR-EPISTEMIC-FRICTION-LENS-2026-09 with dimensions FR-A (Epistemic Freedom) through FR-D (Structured Holism). NOTE: this file attributes the book to 'Sher'; a later file in this same batch (source-misattribution-correction-the-volume-is-minica-not-sher, S2856) reports a correction regarding volume attribution within this thread -- flagged for cross-reference, not resolved within this file.

aliases: Gang of Four Design Patterns as a comparative/falsification research lens
note: Reads the Gang-of-Four Design Patterns catalogue (23 patterns, each recording intent/applicability/constraints/participants/collaboration/consequences/trade-offs from real systems) not as a source of KnowledgeOS primitives but as an empirical catalogue of recurring responsibility structures, used to test whether KnowledgeOS candidate operations (Operation, Zoom-In, Epistemic Agency, Zoom-Out/preservation, state notification) are reducible to known patterns (Command, Visitor, Strategy, Chain of Responsibility, State, Memento, Observer, Composite) or expose a genuinely new class of operational problem. Explicitly connects to the corpus's existing Step 290 operation-semantics research (identity != semantics != execution).
